scope_correction_counterexample.message: Scope change not allowed in state upgrade

impact: Original rejected scope remains immutable through allowed local patch interface, even when independent review locates a scope contradiction. This is a generic interface limitation, not proof of missing biological evidence.
recommendation: Future version may add task-targeted scope/simplification edits with immutable original requirements and independent scope review. Do not reset this experiment attempt limits or claim a correction has been demonstrated.
